text: My God, my God, why have you deserted me? You are far from saving me, far from the words of my groaning.
My God, I call out by day but you do not answer, and by night, and I find no rest.
Yet you are holy, enthroned on the praises of Israel.
Our ancestors trusted in you; they trusted, and you rescued them.
They cried out to you and were saved; they trusted you and were never disappointed.
But I am a worm and not a man, scorned by everyone, despised by the people.
Everyone who sees me mocks me; they sneer and shake their heads at me.
He relied on the LORD, so let the LORD rescue him, since he delights in him.
Yet you brought me out of the womb; you made me trust you even at my mother's breast.
I was placed in your care from the moment of birth; you have been my God since my mother bore me.
Do not stay far from me, for trouble is near and there is no one to help.
Many bulls surround me; strong bulls of Bashan close in around me.
They open their mouths at me like a roaring, tearing lion.
I am poured out like water, and all my bones are pulled out of joint; my heart has turned to wax, melting inside me.
My strength has dried up like a piece of broken pottery, and my tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth; you lay me down in the dust of death.
Dogs surround me; a gang of evildoers closes in on me; they have pierced my hands and my feet.
I can count every one of my bones; people stare at me and gloat.
They divide up my clothes among themselves and cast lots for what I am wearing.
But you, LORD, do not stay far away; you are my strength, so come quickly and help me.
Rescue my life from the sword, my only life from the power of the dogs.
Save me from the lion's mouth; you have answered me and kept me from the horns of the wild oxen.
I will declare your name to my brothers; in the middle of the assembly I will praise you.
You who fear the LORD, praise him. All you offspring of Jacob, honor him; stand in awe of him, all Israel's descendants.
For he has not despised or turned away from the suffering of the afflicted one; he has not hidden his face from him but has listened when he cried out for help.
My praise in the great assembly comes from you; I will keep my vows in front of those who fear him.
The poor will eat and be satisfied; those who seek the LORD will praise him — may your hearts live forever.
All the ends of the earth will remember and turn back to the LORD; all the families of the nations will bow down before him.
For kingship belongs to the LORD, and he rules over the nations.
All the rich of the earth will feast and bow down; all who go down to the dust will kneel before him, even those who cannot keep themselves alive.
Future generations will serve him; they will tell the next generation about the Lord.
They will come and announce his righteousness to a people not yet born, declaring that he has done it.
